scope: Frozen PushT expert final evaluation; separate from policy/Cube/model-extension completion. Existing15downstream-unexposed initialstate families/45states; upstream WM training exposure not excluded. No new thresholds/layers/hyperparameters chosen from test. Development/calibration diagnostics retained unchanged.
interpretation: Primary U is applied correction AND dense object preservation AND executed jerk reduction>=10%. Report paired family bootstrap95%interval. CI lower>0 supports positive difference; CI lower>=0.10 needed to establish the declared practical difference. Also require measured overall/contact selected-risk<=0.1 and active>=0.25; these are empirical endpoints, not certified population risk. No equivalence conclusion from nonsignificance. Secondary/multiple-method contrasts exploratory without multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory claims.
cost_comparison: Use frozen calibration budget selections; measure test latency/performance without choosing profiles from test. CPU/GPU costs and wider correction freedom of full-command baselines explicit.
oracle: Best physically preserving candidate in each declared bank, diagnostic only, never selector input. No assertion of global optimum.
horizon_note: H10/20 F1 candidate search is a locked diagnostic, not a retuned deployable selector. Repeated H20 uses existing fixed rules. Final primary hypothesis remains H5.
